author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter Jess Williamson visited The Current to record a session in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Recorded in front of a live audience, Williamson also had a chat with host Mac Wilson about her new record 'A Mile South of Heaven."

Watch and listen to the full session and interview at thecurrent.org and on our YouTube channel.
